name: uteamup-zcode
description: Connect ZCode to UteamUP CMMS for read-only work orders, assets, and maintenance data via Model Context Protocol (MCP), signing in with your UteamUP account.

description_i18n.en: Connect ZCode to UteamUP CMMS for read-only work orders, assets, and maintenance data via Model Context Protocol (MCP), signing in with your UteamUP account.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）将 ZCode 连接到 UteamUP CMMS，以只读方式查询工单、资产和维保数据，并使用您自己的 UteamUP 账号登录授权。
